title: TCPConfiguration
description: TCPConfiguration contains all the TCP configuration parameters.

middlewares.description: Middlewares is the list of MiddlewareRef which composes the chain.

inFlightConn.description: InFlightConn defines the InFlightConn middleware configuration.

amount.description: Amount defines the maximum amount of allowed simultaneous connections. The middleware closes the connection if there are already amount connections opened.

ipAllowList.description: IPAllowList defines the IPAllowList middleware configuration. This middleware accepts/refuses connections based on the client IP. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/routing-configuration/tcp/middlewares/ipallowlist/

sourceRange.description: SourceRange defines the allowed IPs (or ranges of allowed IPs by using CIDR notation).

ipWhiteList.description: IPWhiteList defines the IPWhiteList middleware configuration. This middleware accepts/refuses connections based on the client IP. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/routing-configuration/tcp/middlewares/ipwhitelist/

sourceRange.description: SourceRange defines the allowed IPs (or ranges of allowed IPs by using CIDR notation).

entryPoints.description: EntryPoints defines the list of entry point names to bind to. Entry points have to be configured in the static configuration. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/install-configuration/entrypoints/ Default: all.

middlewares.description: Middlewares is the list of MiddlewareRef which composes the chain.

priority.description: Priority defines the router's priority. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/routing-configuration/http/routing/rules-and-priority/#priority

service.description: Service defines the reference to a Kubernetes Service that will serve the error page. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/routing-configuration/http/middlewares/errorpages/#service

tls.description: TLS defines the configuration used to secure the connection to the authentication server.

certResolver.description: CertResolver defines the name of the certificate resolver to use. Cert resolvers have to be configured in the static configuration. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/install-configuration/tls/certificate-resolvers/acme/

domains.description: Domains defines the list of domains that will be used to issue certificates. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/routing-configuration/http/tls/tls-certificates/#domains

main.description: Main defines the main domain name.

sans.description: SANs defines the subject alternative domain names.

options.description: Options defines the reference to a TLSOption, that specifies the parameters of the TLS connection. If not defined, the `default` TLSOption is used. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/reference/routing-configuration/http/tls/tls-options/

passthrough.description: Passthrough defines whether a TLS router will terminate the TLS connection.

dialKeepAlive.description: DialKeepAlive is the interval between keep-alive probes for an active network connection. If zero, keep-alive probes are sent with a default value (currently 15 seconds), if supported by the protocol and operating system. Network protocols or operating systems that do not support keep-alives ignore this field. If negative, keep-alive probes are disabled.

dialTimeout.description: DialTimeout is the amount of time to wait until a connection to a backend server can be established.

proxyProtocol.description: ProxyProtocol holds the PROXY Protocol configuration.

version.description: Version defines the PROXY Protocol version to use.

terminationDelay.description: TerminationDelay, corresponds to the deadline that the proxy sets, after one of its connected peers indicates it has closed the writing capability of its connection, to close the reading capability as well, hence fully terminating the connection. It is a duration in milliseconds, defaulting to 100. A negative value means an infinite deadline (i.e. the reading capability is never closed).

tls.description: TLS defines the configuration used to secure the connection to the authentication server.

certificates.description: Certificates is a list of secret names, each secret holding a key/certificate pair to add to the store.

peerCertURI.description: MaxIdleConnsPerHost controls the maximum idle (keep-alive) to keep per-host. PeerCertURI defines the peer cert URI used to match against SAN URI during the peer certificate verification.

rootCAs.description: RootCAs defines a list of CA certificate Secrets or ConfigMaps used to validate server certificates.

serverName.description: ServerName defines the server name used to contact the server.

ids.description: IDs defines the allowed SPIFFE IDs (takes precedence over the SPIFFE TrustDomain).

trustDomain.description: TrustDomain defines the allowed SPIFFE trust domain.

services.description: Services defines the list of Kubernetes Service and/or TraefikService to load-balance, with weight.

healthCheck.description: Healthcheck defines health checks for ExternalName services.

interval.description: Interval defines the frequency of the health check calls for healthy targets. Default: 30s

port.description: Port defines the port of a Kubernetes Service. This can be a reference to a named port.

timeout.description: Timeout defines how much time the middleware is allowed to retry the request. The value of timeout should be provided in seconds or as a valid duration format, see https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration.

unhealthyInterval.description: UnhealthyInterval defines the frequency of the health check calls for unhealthy targets. When UnhealthyInterval is not defined, it defaults to the Interval value. Default: 30s

proxyProtocol.description: ProxyProtocol holds the PROXY Protocol configuration.

version.description: Version defines the PROXY Protocol version to use.

address.description: Address defines the authentication server address.

tls.description: TLS defines the configuration used to secure the connection to the authentication server.

serversTransport.description: ServersTransport defines the name of ServersTransport resource to use. It allows to configure the transport between Traefik and your servers. Can only be used on a Kubernetes Service.

terminationDelay.description: TerminationDelay, corresponds to the deadline that the proxy sets, after one of its connected peers indicates it has closed the writing capability of its connection, to close the reading capability as well, hence fully terminating the connection. It is a duration in milliseconds, defaulting to 100. A negative value means an infinite deadline (i.e. the reading capability is never closed).

weighted.description: Weighted defines the Weighted Round Robin configuration.

healthCheck.description: Healthcheck defines health checks for ExternalName services.

services.description: Services defines the list of Kubernetes Service and/or TraefikService to load-balance, with weight.

name.description: Name defines the name of the referenced IngressRoute resource.

weight.description: Weight defines the weight and should only be specified when Name references a TraefikService object (and to be precise, one that embeds a Weighted Round Robin).
